description: You are a business continuity planner at Pinnacle Financial Group, a mid-size financial services firm. Open /home/ga/Documents/bia_notes.docx, which contains raw notes from stakeholder interviews about 6 critical business processes and their dependencies. The notes are unstructured paragraphs with recovery time data, dependency information, and impact assessments scattered throughout. Transform these interview notes into a formal Business Impact Analysis (BIA) document following ISO 22301 standards. The final document must include: a properly structured heading hierarchy with standard BIA sections, a Risk Assessment Matrix table (5x5 grid mapping likelihood vs. impact), a Recovery Priority table listing each process with its RTO, RPO, MTPD, and priority tier, a RACI responsibility matrix for the recovery procedures, and an executive summary synthesizing the key findings. All tables must be professionally formatted. Save the formatted document.

metadata.data_source: ISO 22301 Business Continuity standard and FEMA BIA template structure
